babyDevelopment.title: Baby's First Sense
babyDevelopment.tip: Your baby's taste buds are now developed. Foods you eat may influence their taste preferences after birth.

nutritionTip.description: Try spinach, lentils, and lean meats to support increased blood volume during pregnancy.

activityGoal.description: Gentle walking or prenatal yoga recommended today. Stay active, stay healthy!

meditation.description: Take 10 minutes today for guided meditation focusing on bonding with your baby.

garbhSanskarMusic.description: Sacred sounds to create positive vibrations for your baby's spiritual development.

affirmation.text: I am strong, I am capable, and I am nurturing new life with love and care.

learningLesson.title: The Power of Garbh Sanskar
learningLesson.content: Ancient wisdom teaches that positive thoughts and sounds during pregnancy influence the baby's consciousness. Speaking lovingly and playing calming music creates lasting bonds.
